title: Russian Bean Tacos
description: Spicy tacos filled with kidney beans, zesty sauce, and topped with molten cheese, inspired by Russian cuisine.

ingredients.name: Zesty Sauce (Russian-inspired)
ingredients.notes: Mix of ketchup, sour cream, and dill

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the kidney beans and cook until heated through.
Add the zesty sauce and stir to combine.
Warm the tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the bean mixture into the shells.
Top with molten cheese and serve immediately.
